title: Score pronunciation with goodness of pronunciation
brief: Compute GOP per aligned phone, flag mispronunciations with a threshold, correlate scores with human ratings, and count phone confusions.
hints: For a segment [phone, start, end), take block = np.log(posteriors[start:end]). gop_log_posterior is block[:, phone].mean().

gop subtracts the per-frame best before averaging: (block[:, phone] - block.max(axis=1)).mean(). With frame posteriors of the canonical phone 0.2 and 0.3 against best 0.7 and 0.5, that is mean(ln 0.2 - ln 0.7, ln 0.3 - ln 0.5) = -0.8818.
average_ranks: give every value its sorted position from 1, then replace each group of equal values by the group's mean rank. The values [3, 5, 5, 8, 9] get ranks [1, 2.5, 2.5, 4, 5].
phone_confusion: np.add.at(matrix, (canonical, recognized), 1) counts every pair, repeats included.
